provenance.init_note: overdispersed init_to_uniform radius2 (Stan/posteriordb default); 10 independent per-chain draws from uniform(-2, 2) unconstrained.
provenance.target_accept_note: multichain GT requires target_accept=0.95: default (0.80) underadapts the funnel-neck step of stoch_vol's state-space posterior, causing 0.12-0.16% structural divergences across two independent seeds (seeds 20260713, 20260714 — both failed at 124/161 div respectively). ta=0.95 (this A3 run, seed 20260715) produced 0.021% div (21 total / 100k draws) with higher ESS (32601 vs ~23-26k). Diagnosed via JP ruling 2026-07-13; A3 probe confirmed the fix.
